summary: SiliconFlow's international pricing page offers $1 in free credits to get started on its serverless inference platform (LLM, image, video, audio models), with postpaid pay-as-you-go billing and no minimum commitment. The separate siliconflow-free-models listing documents selected models marked free in the mainland-China catalog at siliconflow.cn/pricing; do not assume those regional free entries are available on the international account or permanently free.
claim_steps: $1 in free credits is granted to get started; no minimum commitment.

For the separate free-model offer, check the regional catalog and account eligibility. Selected models are marked free at https://siliconflow.cn/pricing; the international $1 signup credit does not itself establish free-model access or permanence.

social_proof.title: Pricing Plans - SiliconFlow
social_proof.text: Flexible token pricing, high usage limits, and postpaid billing—plus $1 in free credits to get you started! There are no minimum commitments. You only pay for what you use, and you can start with $1 in free credits.
